characters.name: Adam
characters.title: First Man, Father of All Living
characters.bio: Formed from the dust of the earth and placed in Eden to dress and keep it, he named every living creature and chose mortality with Eve. All the families of the earth trace back to his covenant altar outside the garden.

characters.name: Eve
characters.title: Mother of All Living
characters.bio: The first woman, whose name means life — she partook, saw the necessity of the fall, and gladdened in the joy of redemption. 'Were it not for our transgression we never should have had seed, and never should have known good and evil.'

characters.name: Enoch
characters.title: Builder of the City of Holiness
characters.bio: The seventh from Adam, a slow-of-speech youth who became a seer before whom mountains fled. He 'walked with God: and he was not; for God took him' — and his whole city of Zion with him.

characters.name: Noah
characters.title: Preacher of Righteousness, Builder of the Ark
characters.bio: A just man who found grace in the eyes of the Lord and spent a lifetime building an ark of gopher wood while the world mocked. Through him every living family was carried over the flood, under the covenant sign of the rainbow.

characters.name: Melchizedek
characters.title: King of Salem, Priest of the Most High God
characters.bio: The king of righteousness and prince of peace who brought forth bread and wine and blessed Abraham returning from battle. So great was his priesthood that the higher order of God's authority bears his name.

characters.name: Abraham
characters.title: Father of the Faithful
characters.bio: Called out of Ur to a land he knew not, he was promised seed as countless as the stars and became the friend of God. On Moriah he lifted the knife over his son of promise, and the covenant that blesses all nations bears his name.

characters.name: Sarah
characters.title: Princess & Mother of Nations
characters.bio: Abraham's wife, whose name the Lord changed from Sarai to 'princess,' promising she would be a mother of nations. She laughed within the tent door at the promise of a son at ninety — and named him Isaac, 'laughter,' when God made good His word.

characters.name: Hagar
characters.title: The Handmaid Whom God Saw
characters.bio: Sarah's Egyptian handmaid, twice driven into the wilderness, where the angel of the Lord found her by a spring. She gave God the name 'Thou God seest me,' and He opened her eyes to a well that saved her son.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.title: Son of Promise
characters.bio: The child of Abraham's and Sarah's old age, who carried the wood up Moriah and lay willingly on the altar — a similitude of the Only Begotten. A quiet patriarch, he reopened his father's wells and passed the covenant to Jacob.

characters.name: Rebekah
characters.title: The Bride at the Well
characters.bio: The maiden who watered ten thirsty camels for a stranger and answered the call to a far country with three words: 'I will go.' Inquiring of the Lord over the twins struggling within her, she was told the elder would serve the younger.

characters.name: Jacob (Israel)
characters.title: The Wrestler Who Became Israel
characters.bio: He saw a ladder reaching into heaven at Bethel and wrestled until the breaking of the day, refusing to let go: 'I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.' Renamed Israel, his twelve sons became the tribes of the covenant people.

characters.name: Rachel
characters.title: Beloved Shepherdess
characters.bio: The shepherdess Jacob met at the well and loved at first sight — seven years of labor for her 'seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.' Mother of Joseph and Benjamin, she died on the road near Bethlehem.

characters.name: Joseph of Egypt
characters.title: The Dreamer Who Saved Nations
characters.bio: Sold by his brothers in his coat of many colors, he rose from the pit and the prison to Pharaoh's right hand, storing grain against seven years of famine. When his brothers stood trembling before him he wept: 'God did send me before you to preserve life.'

characters.name: Pharaoh
characters.title: Hard-Hearted King of Egypt
characters.bio: The throne of Egypt as scripture meets it — the king who exalted Joseph, and the later king 'which knew not Joseph,' whose hardened heart brought ten plagues and drowned an army in the Red Sea.

characters.name: Miriam
characters.title: Prophetess of the Timbrel
characters.bio: The watchful sister who stood among the reeds to guard the infant Moses, and the prophetess who led Israel's women in dance on the far shore: 'Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously.'

characters.name: Aaron
characters.title: First High Priest of Israel
characters.bio: Moses' elder brother and spokesman, whose rod became a serpent before Pharaoh and later budded with almond blossoms as heaven's witness. Consecrated the first high priest, he bore the names of Israel's tribes upon his breastplate.

characters.name: Joshua
characters.title: Conqueror of Canaan
characters.bio: Moses' minister and one of two faithful spies, commanded to be 'strong and of a good courage.' He led Israel dry-shod over Jordan, circled Jericho until the walls fell, and left them a choice: 'as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.'

characters.name: Rahab
characters.title: The Scarlet Cord of Jericho
characters.bio: The woman of Jericho who hid the Israelite spies under stalks of flax, confessing 'the Lord your God, he is God in heaven above.' The scarlet cord in her window saved her whole household — and she stands in the lineage of David and of Christ.

characters.name: Deborah
characters.title: Prophetess & Judge of Israel
characters.bio: 'A mother in Israel' who judged the nation beneath her palm tree and summoned Barak to battle — going with him when he would not go alone. Her victory song exults that 'the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.'

characters.name: Gideon
characters.title: Judge of the Three Hundred
characters.bio: Found threshing wheat in hiding, hailed by the angel as a 'mighty man of valour.' With torches, pitchers, and three hundred men who lapped like dogs, he routed the Midianite host — and refused a crown: 'the Lord shall rule over you.'

characters.name: Samson
characters.title: Strong Man of the Nazarites
characters.bio: A Nazarite from the womb whose unshorn hair held the secret of impossible strength — until Delilah's persistence wore him down. Blind and bound between the pillars of Dagon's house, he prayed once more and brought it down.

characters.name: Ruth
characters.title: Faithful Daughter of Moab
characters.bio: The Moabite widow who bound herself to Naomi with one of scripture's tenderest vows: 'whither thou goest, I will go... thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.' Gleaning in the fields of Boaz, she became great-grandmother of King David.

characters.name: Naomi
characters.title: The Mother-in-Law Restored
characters.bio: Emptied by famine and the graves of her husband and sons, she asked to be called Mara, 'for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.' Ruth's loyalty and Boaz's kindness filled her arms again, with Obed upon her lap.

characters.name: Boaz
characters.title: Kinsman-Redeemer of Bethlehem
characters.bio: A mighty man of wealth who greeted his reapers with 'The Lord be with you,' and spread his skirt over the gleaning stranger. As kinsman-redeemer he bought back Naomi's inheritance and took Ruth to wife at the city gate.

characters.name: Hannah
characters.title: The Praying Mother
characters.bio: She wept in bitterness of soul at Shiloh, her lips moving in silent prayer until Eli thought her drunken. 'For this child I prayed' — and she lent little Samuel to the Lord all the days of his life, bringing him a new coat each year.

characters.name: Samuel
characters.title: Prophet & Maker of Kings
characters.bio: The boy who answered a voice in the night, 'Speak; for thy servant heareth,' and grew into the prophet whose words never fell to the ground. He anointed both Saul and David, teaching that 'the Lord looketh on the heart.'

characters.name: Saul
characters.title: First King of Israel
characters.bio: Head and shoulders taller than any of the people, found hiding among the baggage on his coronation day. Anointed with promise, he was undone by impatience and jealousy — 'to obey is better than sacrifice' — and fell on his own sword at Gilboa.

characters.name: David
characters.title: Shepherd King of Israel
characters.bio: The ruddy shepherd boy who felled Goliath with a sling and a stone 'in the name of the Lord of hosts,' and rose to unite Israel from Jerusalem. Psalmist, warrior, and penitent — the man after God's own heart who sang 'The Lord is my shepherd.'

characters.name: Jonathan
characters.title: The Prince Who Loved David
characters.bio: Saul's valiant son, who climbed a cliff with only his armourbearer trusting that 'there is no restraint to the Lord to save by many or by few.' His soul was knit with David's; he gave the future king his own robe, sword, and bow.

characters.name: Goliath
characters.title: Champion of Gath
characters.bio: The Philistine giant of six cubits and a span, whose brass armor and defiant morning challenge froze Israel's army for forty days — until a shepherd boy ran toward him with five smooth stones.

characters.name: Nathan
characters.title: The Prophet Who Told the King a Story
characters.bio: Court prophet to David, who carried the promise of an everlasting house — and the rebuke of a parable about one little ewe lamb. When the king condemned the rich man in the tale, Nathan answered: 'Thou art the man.'

characters.name: Solomon
characters.title: Wise King & Builder of the Temple
characters.bio: David's son, who asked God not for riches but for 'an understanding heart' — and discerned the true mother with a drawn sword. He built the temple in seven years and filled Jerusalem with proverbs, though his own heart was turned away at last.

characters.name: Elijah
characters.title: Prophet of Fire
characters.bio: The Tishbite who sealed the heavens for three and a half years, called down fire on Carmel — 'if the Lord be God, follow him' — and heard the Lord not in wind or earthquake but in a still small voice. He departed in a chariot of fire, keys in hand for a latter day.

characters.name: Elisha
characters.title: Prophet of the Double Portion
characters.bio: The plowman who left twelve yoke of oxen to pour water on Elijah's hands, and asked for a double portion of his master's spirit. He multiplied the widow's oil, raised the Shunammite's son, and showed his servant the mountain 'full of horses and chariots of fire.'

characters.name: Ahab
characters.title: The King Who Sold Himself
characters.bio: King of Israel who married Jezebel, built a house to Baal in Samaria, and 'did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the Lord.' He sulked for Naboth's vineyard, and died in disguise from an arrow drawn at a venture.

characters.name: Jezebel
characters.title: Idolatrous Queen of Israel
characters.bio: The Sidonian princess who fed four hundred prophets of Baal at her table, slew the prophets of the Lord, and forged letters to steal Naboth's vineyard by his blood. Her name became scripture's byword for painted, unrepentant power.

characters.name: Naaman
characters.title: The Leprous Captain Made Clean
characters.bio: Captain of the host of Syria, 'a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.' A little captive maid pointed him to the prophet, and after raging at the plainness of the cure, he dipped seven times in Jordan and came up with the flesh of a little child.

characters.name: Hezekiah
characters.title: The King Who Trusted the Lord
characters.bio: King of Judah who spread Sennacherib's blasphemous letter before the Lord in the temple — and an angel scattered the Assyrian host by morning. Granted fifteen more years of life, he watched the shadow go ten degrees backward on the dial of Ahaz.

characters.name: Josiah
characters.title: The Boy King Who Found the Book
characters.bio: Crowned at eight, he began at sixteen to seek the God of David his father. When the lost book of the law was found in the temple he rent his clothes, gathered all Judah, and led the greatest reformation and Passover since the days of the judges.

characters.name: Jeremiah
characters.title: The Weeping Prophet
characters.bio: Called before he was formed in the belly, he preached forty years to a city that would not hear — beaten, put in stocks, and lowered into a miry dungeon. He could not stay silent: the word was 'in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones.'

characters.name: Ezekiel
characters.title: Watchman of the Exile
characters.bio: Priest and prophet among the captives by the river Chebar, who saw wheels within wheels and the glory of the Lord departing — and returning. Set as a watchman unto Israel, he prophesied to a valley of dry bones until they stood, 'an exceeding great army.'

characters.name: Daniel
characters.title: Prophet of the Lions' Den
characters.bio: Carried captive as a youth, he purposed in his heart not to defile himself with the king's meat, interpreted dreams no wise man could touch, and prayed toward Jerusalem three times a day though the den of lions waited. 'My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths.'

characters.name: Shadrach, Meshach & Abed-nego
characters.title: The Three in the Fiery Furnace
characters.bio: Three Hebrew captives who would not bow to the golden image: 'our God whom we serve is able to deliver us... But if not, we will not serve thy gods.' Cast bound into the furnace heated seven times over, they walked free — with a fourth, 'like the Son of God.'

characters.name: Nebuchadnezzar
characters.title: King of Babylon the Great
characters.bio: The conqueror who burned Jerusalem and carried Judah captive, dreamed of a great image and a stone cut without hands, and boasted of 'great Babylon, that I have built' — until he ate grass as oxen for seven seasons and learned that the heavens do rule.

characters.name: Esther
characters.title: Queen for Such a Time as This
characters.bio: The orphaned Jewish maiden who became queen of Persia and hid her people until the hour of their peril. Fasting three days, she entered the king's court unbidden — 'and if I perish, I perish' — and turned Haman's decree of death into deliverance.

characters.name: Mordecai
characters.title: Guardian at the King's Gate
characters.bio: Esther's cousin and foster father, who sat in the king's gate, refused to bow to Haman, and sent the question that steadied a queen: 'who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?' He rode the king's horse Haman meant for himself.

characters.name: Haman
characters.title: The Agagite Plotter
characters.bio: The proud vizier of Persia who, for one man's unbent knee, cast lots to destroy an entire people. He built a gallows fifty cubits high for Mordecai — and was hanged on it himself.

characters.name: Job
characters.title: The Patient Sufferer of Uz
characters.bio: A man perfect and upright, stripped in a single day of children, wealth, and health, who worshipped in the ashes: 'the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.' Out of the whirlwind he heard God, and out of anguish he testified, 'I know that my redeemer liveth.'

characters.name: Jonah
characters.title: The Reluctant Prophet
characters.bio: He fled toward Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, was cast into the sea, and prayed from the belly of the great fish. Nineveh repented at his eight-word sermon — and God taught his pouting prophet mercy with a gourd, a worm, and an east wind.

characters.name: Hosea
characters.title: Prophet of the Broken Heart
characters.bio: Commanded to marry a wife of whoredoms and love her still, his home became a living parable of God's covenant with wayward Israel. His book aches with divine longing: 'How shall I give thee up, Ephraim?... I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely.'

characters.name: Amos
characters.title: Herdsman Prophet of Justice
characters.bio: 'No prophet, neither a prophet's son,' but a herdman and gatherer of sycomore fruit, sent from Tekoa to thunder at comfortable Israel: 'let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.' He declared that God 'revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.'

characters.name: Micah
characters.title: Prophet of Bethlehem's Promise
characters.bio: The Moreshite who foresaw that out of little Bethlehem Ephratah would come the ruler 'whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.' He distilled all the law's demands into one verse: 'to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.'

characters.name: Zechariah
characters.title: Prophet of Visions & the Branch
characters.bio: A prophet of night visions — the man among the myrtle trees, the golden candlestick fed by two olive trees, Joshua the high priest clothed anew before the accuser. He stirred the returned exiles to finish the temple 'not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord.'

characters.name: Ezra
characters.title: Scribe of the Law
characters.bio: A ready scribe in the law of Moses who 'prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach' it in Israel. He led a company home from Babylon and read the law to all the people from morning until midday, giving the sense.

characters.name: Nehemiah
characters.title: Cupbearer Who Rebuilt the Wall
characters.bio: Cupbearer to the king of Persia, whose sad face over Jerusalem's ruins won him leave, letters, and timber. He rebuilt the wall in fifty-two days with a sword in one hand and a trowel in the other, answering every distraction: 'I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down.'

characters.name: Cyrus
characters.title: The Lord's Anointed of Persia
characters.bio: The Persian conqueror named by Isaiah generations before his birth — 'my shepherd,' who would say to Jerusalem, 'Thou shalt be built.' In his first year over Babylon he decreed the exiles' return and restored the vessels of the house of the Lord.

characters.name: Satan
characters.title: The Adversary & Accuser
characters.bio: The adversary who walks 'to and fro in the earth' — presenting himself among the sons of God to accuse Job, and standing at the high priest's right hand in Zechariah's vision until rebuked: 'The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan... is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?'

characters.name: The Chronicler
characters.title: Unnamed Keeper of Israel's Story
characters.bio: The unnamed narrator behind Israel's histories — Judges, Ruth, Samuel, Kings, Chronicles, Esther, Job — who wove court records, prophets' scrolls, and genealogies into the long testimony that the Lord keeps covenant from generation to generation.

characters.name: The Psalmist
characters.title: Voice of Israel's Songs
characters.bio: The voice of the Psalter where it is not David's — sons of Korah, Moses, and singers unnamed — crying from the depths and shouting from the heights: 'my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.'

characters.name: Asaph
characters.title: Chief Musician of David
characters.bio: A Levite seer appointed by David to sound the cymbals before the ark and give thanks before the Lord continually. Twelve psalms bear his name, including the honest confession of envy healed in the sanctuary: 'it is good for me to draw near to God.'

groups.name: The Israelites
groups.bio: The children of Israel — twelve tribes brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand, covenanted at Sinai, and led by cloud and fire toward a promised land they would win, lose, and long for again.

groups.name: The Philistines
groups.bio: The sea-people of the five cities — Gaza, Gath, Ashkelon, Ashdod, and Ekron — perennial foes of the judges and kings, whose champion fell to a shepherd's stone and whose god Dagon fell on his face before the ark.

groups.name: The Babylonians
groups.bio: The empire of the great city on the Euphrates that burned the temple and carried Judah into seventy years of captivity — by whose rivers the exiles wept when they remembered Zion.
